about: Who proposed a Proposal (graph spec section 23 rule 6, section 24 H3 rule 4; 16 Oct 2026): the Proposal is WAS_ATTRIBUTED_TO a Ref to a Model. The old form, an Activity the Proposal WAS_GENERATED_BY that is ASSOCIATED_WITH the Model, is still accepted for one release, with a warning naming the fix. Both readers run these cases: packages/graph-spec/test/proposers.test.mjs and python/graph_spec/tests/test_proposers.py. Each case gives its blocks, the judgement graph, whether rule 6 holds and the warnings, sorted.
rule6: §23 rule 6: every proposal is attributed to the model that proposed it

cases.name: a proposal attributed to a model holds, with no warning
a proposal that names its model through its activity still holds, with a warning naming the fix
warnings: pr names its proposer through ASSOCIATED_WITH on its activity act: attribute it with (pr)-[:WAS_ATTRIBUTED_TO]->(r_planner) instead; the old form is accepted for one release

cases.name: a proposal attributed to nobody fails
a proposal attributed to a person fails
a proposal with a model beside a person fails, in either form
warnings: pr names its proposer through ASSOCIATED_WITH on its activity act: attribute it with (pr)-[:WAS_ATTRIBUTED_TO]->(r_sam) instead; the old form is accepted for one release
